science: Root read actual README/starter/oracle/direct factorial-moment reference/tests/validator/author/prototype and reviewed reports. Independently checked Hamiltonian and column-major Liouvillian, stationary coherence sign, integrated connected covariance, emission-conditioned seed and eta/Gamma factors, factorial-moment hierarchy and thinning. Source has correct Bloch dynamics and symmetrized population covariance but treats it as nondestructive intensity noise; exact emitted counts instead condition the emitter. Direct 2x2 count-moment ODE is independent of oracle block exponential.
public_input_review: Explicit basis/Hamiltonian, vacuum Markov radiative decay, stationary preparation, fluorescence-only port with elastic component included, broadband unfiltered independent thinning and actual finite-gate count variance uniquely define readout. No jump-conditioning correction or antibunching hint. Neutral full-replacement instruction; None parameter; no private answers in public image and no model-form inspection in grading.
calibration_review: 144 readings at24 mean-count settings spanning drive, signed detuning, decay and duration. Positive known basis times unknown efficiency gives unique noiseless fit and exact source/oracle calibration equivalence. Sigma .0004 is fixed independently of signal and efficiency.
grading_review: All256 noisy fits/calibration/parameter/oracle checks pass. Oracle hidden worst .000132; source minimum variance error .85512 at standard .04 gate.64domain controls agree with independent direct moment ODE within1.96e-12; counting-field derivatives, number-resolved probabilities, cutoff/refinement, stationarity, thinning, detuning symmetry, dark and short-gate limits pass. Localoracle7/7 andsource4pass+3intendedvariancefailures under.5seconds.
classification_caveat: Retaining symmetrized population noise as actual photon-count covariance is physical detection failure. Correct jump conditioning with regression, sign, prefactor or integration mistakes must be classified separately.
